d: Tens of thousands of workers and students took to the streets across Italy on Friday as the country’s largest trade union, CGIL, launched a 24-hour nationwide general strike against stagnant wages, soaring living costs, and cuts to essential public services. With demonstrations planned in more than 100 cities—stretching from Milan and Turin in the north to Rome, Naples, and Palermo in the south—the walkout disrupted public transport networks, schools, and healthcare facilities across the country.
